parsed.name: 海洋光学 OOI USB 通信组件
parsed.name_en: Ocean Optics OOI USB Communication Component
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理软件组件，用于实验软件中与海洋光学光谱仪建立底层 USB 通信。它负责打开和关闭设备连接、发送 OOI 协议命令、发起查询并读取返回数据，供上层光谱采集与仪器控制逻辑调用。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component used in laboratory software to provide low-level USB communication with Ocean Optics spectrometers. It handles opening and closing the device connection, sending OOI-protocol commands, initiating queries, and reading returned data for higher-level acquisition and instrument-control logic.
